description: Verify that a previous mutation actually landed on Spotify by looking up its receipt. Receipts are session-scoped: the 100 most recent mutations, in this process only, and lost on restart unless SPOTIFY_MCP_RECEIPTS is set. An unknown or expired id returns isError with found:false — a fact about the lookup, not about the mutation.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID copied verbatim from a receipt-bearing mutation result (rcpt_<bootId>-<n>)

name: verify_receipt
